actions.reason: Add a global model rendering prefix cache for saves with the same pattern, special tokens, and an extending merge sequence. New tokenizer instances that save growing merge prefixes can reuse the already rendered model header and merge lines, then append only the new suffix while preserving the existing load-cache population.
